summary: Vaxcyte filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing positive topline Phase 3 OPUS-1 data for VAX-31, its 31-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine candidate, in adults. VAX-31 met all prespecified primary endpoints across age groups versus Prevnar 20 and Capvaxive, including noninferiority at the 0.667 threshold and superiority for unique serotypes. A press release and slide presentation were furnished as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2. No transaction, stakeholder, or structural event is present; this is an ordinary product-data disclosure, not a special situation.
